independent_oracle.force: CCSD(T)-corrected Lambda amplitudes supplied to analytic gradient.

limitations: Separate allocations on shared nodes; cold/changed one sample and warm two samples per variant, not isolated-machine confidence intervals.
Memcheck timings are retained but excluded from performance comparisons.
The cache ends with each standalone RHF call and is not borrowed by the later MO provider. Each of the four calls rebuilds it once.
Only s/p reference caches up to 256 MiB are eligible; larger or higher-angular references retain bounded matrix-direct execution.
The public CCSD(T) force boundary remains 28 AOs. This change does not qualify the separate 56-AO degenerate-subspace force case.

qualification.native_resource_probe_scope: Independent CPU physical frame parity, exact optional-cache admission and one-byte-below fallback, minimum and minimum-minus-one, injected optional allocation failure, teardown, changed geometry and higher-angular fallback. Locally compiled with ccache and executed through Slurm; remote pytest wrappers skipped because node1 lacks ccache.

reproduction: Build commit 1851ed5cf with CUDA 12.9, sm_120, Release and explicit CXX/CUDA ccache launchers; set CCACHE_BASEDIR to the checkout root.
Inside a finite main-partition Slurm job set GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:., and OMP_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. Preserve scheduler CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
Run the driver with --device cuda --atoms 12 or 24; add --forces only for the 12-atom case. Use --output under .artifacts and set GENERATIVEQC_DF_PROGRESS_TRACE to a fresh JSONL path.
timing_boundary: Complete prepared singlepoint energy or energy+forces call, cold, twice warm, and after moving atom 1 by +0.01 Bohr in z. Preparation is recorded separately.
work_interpretation: Each entry matches cold/warm/warm-repeat/changed. Every reference builds one dense ERI tensor and reuses it for all physical Fock operators. These are completed value counts, not nonzero primitive or GPU-launch counts. Baseline RHF counts were not instrumented; both variants retain their full public CC work counters.
